### Informatica

Informatica from Salesforce delivers agentic and headless data management, governed metadata, and AI-ready pipelines across any cloud. Powered by Claire AI, it turns trusted, connected data into ready-to-use intelligence anywhere.

### Data 360

Teach your AI how your business actually works. Data 360 takes your structured records and unstructured files and enriches them into structured context. This eliminates AI hallucinations, reduces model processing costs, and ensures AI agents execute tasks using your actual business rules.

### Tableau Semantics

Tableau Semantics is the AI-powered semantic layer built into Data 360 and Tableau Next, letting you define data models once with AI-assisted modelling, then activate trusted, governed insights everywhere via any agent or app.

### Salesforce Guardian

Salesforce Guardian is Salesforce’s suite of data security, privacy, and resilience add-on products that protect your org — simplifying compliance, strengthening security posture, enabling proactive threat detection, and governing structured and unstructured data.

### Mulesoft

MuleSoft’s Anypoint Platform lets you build reusable APIs to connect any system, app, or device — unlocking data, automating workflows, and now governing AI agents at scale via Agent Fabric, all with built-in security.

### Agent Fabric

MuleSoft Agent Fabric is an enterprise agent control plane that discovers, orchestrates, governs, and observes any AI agent regardless of where it’s built — turning scattered, unmanaged agents into a secure, coordinated network built on MuleSoft.

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM (customer relationship management) platform. We bring companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by agentic AI and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT, work as one. You can learn more about what Salesforce is and what Salesforce does by visiting our official resources . Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads, close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic platform.

### What is CRM and why do I need one?

CRM stands for customer relationship management. It’s a technology for managing all your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system helps you: • Organise contact information, leads, and customer service data • Automate tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails • Analyse data to understand customer behaviour and business performance A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you a single , 360-degree view of every customer , allowing you to build stronger, more profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

Agentic AI refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act autonomously to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike traditional AI that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan multistep actions, and execute tasks. In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our Agentforce technology — is used to: • Automate complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution • Predict business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close • Personalise every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help my small business grow?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from startups and small businesses to large global enterprises. Our Headless Toolkit is flexible and scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for what you use and have an AI and CRM platform that can grow with your business. Salesforce Starter helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.
